products.name: Jamf AI Governance
products.note: Native AI control plane for macOS fleets, GA July 1, 2026; discovery and policy enforcement for on-device and cloud AI use on Mac endpoints

profile_text.body:
Jamf, founded in 2002 and headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, describes itself as a provider of enterprise Apple device management and security. The company's site states it helps organizations manage Apple devices including Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and Apple TV, connecting users to resources and protecting businesses from cyber threats. Jamf claims over 20 years of experience, same-day Apple OS support, and positions itself as the only company offering a complete management and security solution for Apple-first enterprise environments. IDC MarketScape placed Jamf in the Leaders Category for Worldwide Unified Endpoint Management Software for Apple Devices in its 2025–2026 Vendor Assessment.

On the AI side, Jamf tracks a product called Jamf AI Governance, categorized as an AI Governance and Risk Management Platform. It is described as a native AI control plane for macOS fleets, with general availability set for July 1, 2026, providing discovery and policy enforcement for on-device and cloud AI use on Mac endpoints.

The site's held facts show Jamf has a notable legal exposure footprint in Minnesota, with 100 cases recorded under that jurisdiction, though no specific litigation details are provided in the available data.
